001402.d: A heavy combat ready machine gun that fires many rounds. Only a handful of these guns were produced.

t: Hold the special to fire one shot every 0.1 seconds at normal-attack power, aimed at your lock-on target or straight ahead. You can turn while firing.
Each shot hits only the first enemy or box on its line, up to 300 units away, and does not pierce.
Each shot uses normal-attack accuracy and costs no HP. The weapon is combo locked: no attack chains into another, so every normal, heavy or special attack starts on its own.
Its normal and heavy attacks cannot be cancelled with Just Guard, the roll or the Mirage warp.

Holding the special heats the weapon. An overheat gauge beside you fills in about 6 seconds of fire. When it is full the weapon stops and cannot attack at all until the gauge is empty again, about 12 seconds later.
Let go before the gauge is full and it cools three times as fast, about 4 seconds from nearly full. The gauge keeps its heat and keeps cooling while another weapon is in hand.

Worn with Rika's Claw or Twin Rika Claws: the Tempest special's Gizonde is 5 levels higher, and every enemy it hits is electrified for 10 seconds. Each one takes a 30% Gizonde every half second, and every 2 seconds it arcs a full-power Gizonde to the enemies near it. Your normal and heavy attacks on an electrified enemy set off both at once. Every enemy those Gizondes hit takes -40% thunder resistance for 60 seconds.
In combat areas you wear a white cloak with black pauldrons and a breastplate.

002002.d: Also known as Envoy of Demise, this axe has the power to cause natural disasters.

t: An axe is held in the left hand, with the right hand on the handle.
Normal and heavy swings hit once each and reach up to 3 targets.

ef: Special attack: Anga Grudda. One press plays six strikes. Each strike hits up to 5 enemies with heavy-attack power, one hit each even on an enemy with several body parts. It costs no TP or HP.
Catalyst: Desert Rift. Defeat 1,000 enemies with Anga Grudda to unlock it for your account.
Desert Rift: for 10 seconds after Anga Grudda ends, each heavy attack strikes twice in quick succession.
Both strikes deal 40% more damage and land with a short hit pause, so heavy attacks deal more damage than Anga Grudda during that time.
While Desert Rift is active, End-If's swing trail turns sand-colored.

ef: Works for a HUnewearl holding Nei's Claw (Real) or Twin Nei Claws (Real). Without one of the two claws it does nothing.
Foie, Barta and Zonde deal 50% more damage and ignore 30% of the enemy's resistance to their element.

Foie no longer flies forward. A fireball circles you for 30 seconds and burns every enemy it touches for 20% of a Foie hit, again and again. It breaks boxes too. Casting Foie again starts the 30 seconds over.
Barta lingers for 5 seconds: after the cast, the same Barta runs down the same line once a second, and each of those passes can freeze what it hits.
Zonde leaves a field of lightning around its target for 10 seconds. Every half second each enemy inside is struck for 20% of a Zonde hit.

so.t: Episode 2, Ultimate: Gi Gue, Sinow Zele and Dolmolm drop it as a Super Rare, 1 in 2,000 per kill.
